name: Lindsi M. Weber
tagline: Top rated Bankruptcy attorney in Phoenix, Arizona
education: Arizona State University Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law
about: An experienced bankruptcy and commercial litigator, Lindsi guides clients through the complexities of bankruptcy litigation utilizing a practical, hands-on approach to help resolve bankruptcy and financial restructuring issues whether on behalf of a Chapter 11 debtor, committee, secured creditor, or party to bankruptcy litigation. Active in the bankruptcy community, she is a past board member of the Maricopa County Bar Association Bankruptcy Section and past President of the NextGen Emerging Leaders Board of the Turnaround Management Association Arizona Chapter. Lindsi also participated as a member of the National Conference of Bankruptcy Judges’ Next Generation program in 2017 and was a member of the American Bankruptcy Institute’s 40 Under 40 Class of 2019. In addition to her time in bankruptcy courts, Lindsi also spends a significant amount of time assisting clients with complex, commercial, probate, and business litigation matters in both State and Federal Courts. She is a firm believer that early intervention, a strong commitment to cost-effective strategies, and utilizing common sense all contribute to positive results for clients.

Prior to law school, Lindsi served as an elementary special education teacher and site director with Teach For America in Phoenix. During college, she was selected as an All-American volleyball player and served as team captain.
